case: crash between prepared, committed and published

scenarios.name: die after the first of 3 renames

expect.plan: finish_forward when staged files are intact
expect.otherwise: restore_prior from hard links; landed files with no prior copy are kept and reported (conflict)

scenarios.name: die after all renames, before the log line

expect.log: record appended exactly once (txn_id), then published

scenarios.name: a newer revision changed a target after prepare
source-edit journal: post digests recorded, then a newer manual edit before recovery
scenarios.expect: recoverJournal returns conflict.kind newer_revision; no status is logged on the edit's behalf

scenarios.name: source-edit journal: died mid-write
scenarios.expect: edit marked conflicted with a restore-checkpoint note

scenarios.name: final delivery: file present, receipt checksum differs
scenarios.expect: publishDeliveredPointer ok false; delivered.json unchanged; no final_ready event

scenarios.name: final delivery: render fails after the previous final existed
